# SycoBench-600 (third-party data)

`questions.json` is the SycoBench-600 dataset, unchanged, from
<https://github.com/debu-sinha/sycobench-600> at commit
`3b2d3680b0a6d456e618206e6281904c87cb49dd` (SHA-256
`ae41f4b94ac46fb0109778546a091534208881cf74eea87c43ce24736bb8dd4d`).

D. Sinha, "SycoBench-600: Measuring Sycophancy and Correction Selectivity in
LLM Assistants," in *Findings of the Association for Computational
Linguistics: ACL 2026*, pp. 35278–35284.
<https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.1759/>

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0),
<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>. No changes were made. It is used
only by `scripts/transfer_sycobench.py`, an exploratory check added after MAIN.
